hanna (marketing): Quick sync  planning micro-launch for 'inference economics' post + ops webinar. Need defensible claims, routing rules, and 2 SDR openers. Draft here: https://redwood-internal/drive/inference-econ-draft
omar (research): quick read. Replace absolutes with ranges and add methods note: 'benchmarks run on commit d4f2; medians are p50/p95 across 7 runs; configs in repo.'
kai (product): add a small technical line for the battlecard about routing: 'policy-driven fallbacks to quantized/regional variants maintain latency targets without replatforming.' Good against infra vendors that require full re-deploys.
zac (growth): inbound routing proposal (Console JSON):
```json
{ "source":"landing","utm_campaign":"infecon_q4","interest":"bench","route":"sdr-bench","priority":18 }
```
Also A/B hero test: A) "Inference you can budget for" B) "Cut token spend, keep model fidelity"
mira (sales): SDR openers (short):
- "Hey  saw you checked our bench. is p95 jitter causing headaches?"
- "Quick q: would predictable reserved pools help your next pilot?"
Add triage fields: pain=latency|cost|compliance; stage=dev|pilot|prod
legal-bot: checked wording. avoid 'beats' or named vendors; ok to say 'shows lower median latency in our benchmarks' and include methodology link.
deploy-bot: Landing + post scheduled: 2025-12-03T15:00:00Z. Social queued for 2025-12-03T16:00:00Z.
hanna (marketing): perfect. last asks: (1) research to push the methods snippet into the post, (2) product to sign off on fallback wording, (3) sales to confirm snippets for Outreach. Can we close by 17:00 PT?
omar (research): will add methods and repo link by 14:30 PT.
kai (product): approved wording.
mira (sales): will upload Outreach snippets + triage fields by 16:30 PT.
